description: This file is the code-behind for the EditMCQ ASP.NET Web Forms page, containing event handlers for UI interactions such as navigation buttons, course selection, and session management. It primarily manages the course dropdown population based on semester selection and handles page transfer events.

classes.name: EditMCQ
classes.description: Code-behind class for the EditMCQ web page handling UI event logic.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Admin Panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Admin Queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Admin Leaderboard page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates course dropdown based on selected semester.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and navigates to the login page.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles change in semester dropdown and updates course list accordingly.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Empty handler for course dropdown change event.
